about: Registry of the data splits behind the ledger rows. A split's first scoring may be held/fresh; every later use is dev, reused or explore. Data is not committed; `regenerate` says how to rebuild it.

henryiv-fr.what: Henry IV Part 1, English (Gutenberg) vs Guizot French, speeches aligned per scene, held out by act

henryiv-de.what: Henry IV Part 1, English vs Wieland German, aligned per act, held out by act

wiki-latin-dev.what: English/French and English/German Wikipedia lead pairs (countries, rivers, mountains, physicists, elements...), acts <= 3

mrpc-dev.what: last third of GLUE MRPC train (by idx)
mrpc-dev.regenerate: MRPC parquet from the GLUE dataset, see mrpc/mrpc.py

mrpc-test.regenerate: MRPC parquet from the GLUE dataset, see mrpc/mrpc.py

f1.what: fresh set 1: capitals by continent and US states, fr/de leads

f2.what: fresh set 2: administrative divisions (Italy, Japan, Switzerland, India, France, Argentina, Germany, Netherlands)

f3.what: fresh set 3: divisions (Thailand, Turkey, Greece, Romania, Iran, Italy regions, Vietnam, Egypt, Croatia, Hungary, Chile)

f4.what: fresh set 4: divisions (Philippines, Kenya, Afghanistan, Indonesia, Colombia, Mexico, Peru, Ukraine, Ghana, Senegal, Norway, Cuba)
